_comment: Order the AI analyst tries endpoints in. The first entry that is usable AND
succeeds wins; a failure falls through to the next. Each entry carries its
own URL, so providers on different hosts and wire formats mix freely.
'byok'   - the provider the user configured in Settings. url/model/key all
come from their stored settings, so this entry has no url here.
'direct' - browser calls `url` itself. `keyFrom` names which stored BYOK
key to send; an entry whose key is missing is skipped, never
'proxy'  - same-origin server route that holds the credential. Use this for
any shared/free-tier key: a key placed in this file would ship to
every visitor's browser and be trivially extracted. The route
(/api/ai/chat/completions) runs its own vendor fallback chain,
declared in server/ai/proxy-chain.json, and answers 503 until an
operator sets at least one AI_PROXY_* key.
enabled: false keeps an entry documented but out of the chain.
